activations.summary: The NBA announced an expansion of its Basketball Without Borders programme in Mumbai, with a week-long camp for 60 top prospects from across South Asia. The clinic features coaching from current NBA players and front-office staff, marking the league's largest grassroots investment in the Indian market to date.
activations.headline: NBA Expands Basketball Without Borders to Mumbai With Largest-Ever India Camp

activations.summary: Formula 1 has unveiled its Fan Zone activation plan for the 2026 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix in Jeddah, featuring a 3-day festival with live music, simulator experiences, and driver meet-and-greets at the Corniche. The expanded fan village doubles its footprint from 2025, reflecting Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 push to position the kingdom as a global entertainment destination.
activations.headline: F1 Doubles Jeddah Fan Zone Footprint Ahead of 2026 Saudi Arabian GP

activations.summary: Real Madrid has partnered with a Japanese entertainment conglomerate to launch a permanent 'Hala Madrid Experience' attraction in Tokyo's Odaiba district, combining VR match recreations with a museum of trophies. The activation targets Japan's growing football fanbase and includes a retail store carrying Japan-exclusive merchandise.
activations.headline: Real Madrid Opens Permanent Fan Experience Centre in Tokyo

activations.summary: City Football Group is expanding its City Football Schools programme to five new Indian cities including Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai, targeting 10,000 youth participants by year-end. The coaching curriculum mirrors Manchester City's academy methodology and will be delivered by CFG-certified Indian coaches.
activations.headline: Manchester City's Football Schools Programme Scales to Five New Indian Cities

activations.summary: The NFL has confirmed Abu Dhabi as the host for its first-ever regular season game in the Middle East, scheduled for Week 6 of the 2026 season at Zayed Sports City Stadium. The announcement follows two years of negotiations and represents the NFL's most ambitious international expansion beyond London and Germany.
activations.headline: NFL Confirms First-Ever Regular Season Game in Abu Dhabi for 2026

activations.summary: LaLiga has signed a multi-year sponsorship deal with Saudi Tourism Authority to promote Spanish football across the Gulf region, including co-branded fan festivals during El Clasico weekends. The partnership includes grassroots coaching academies in Riyadh and Jeddah operated under the LaLiga Grassroots banner.
activations.headline: LaLiga Signs Strategic Partnership With Saudi Tourism Authority
